description: This file defines data structures, types, and functions related to 'boards' and 'blocks' in a project, including creation, comparison, and patch generation for board objects and their properties.

classes.name: Board
classes.description: Represents a board with properties such as id, teamId, title, description, type, roles, and timestamps.

classes.name: BoardPatch
classes.description: Represents a set of changes (patches) to a Board object, including updated properties and card properties.

classes.name: BoardMember
classes.description: Represents a member of a board with roles and permissions.

classes.name: BoardsAndBlocks
classes.description: Contains arrays of boards and blocks associated with a project.

classes.name: BoardsAndBlocksPatch
classes.description: Represents patches for multiple boards and blocks, including their IDs and individual patches.

classes.name: IPropertyOption
classes.description: Defines options for a property, including id, value, and color.

classes.name: IPropertyTemplate
classes.description: Template for a card property attached to a board, including id, name, type, and options.

classes.name: BoardGroup
classes.description: Groups cards under a specific property option.

methods.name: createBoard
methods.description: Creates a new Board object, optionally cloning from an existing one, initializing default values and properties.

methods.name: getPropertiesDifference
methods.description: Returns a list of property IDs present in the first list but not in the second.

methods.name: isPropertyEqual
methods.description: Checks if two property templates are equal, including options.

methods.name: createCardPropertiesPatches
methods.description: Generates patches for updating card properties, including delta and undo patches.

methods.name: createPatchesFromBoards
methods.description: Creates patches for updating a board, including properties and card properties, with undo capability.

methods.name: createPatchesFromBoardsAndBlocks
methods.description: Creates patches for a combination of boards and blocks, including undo patches.
